events.title: Angular Keynote
events.description: The future of the framework revealed. Join the Angular team as they unveil the latest advancements in reactivity, hydration, and tooling.

events.title: Signals Deep Dive
events.description: Bring a laptop for a 90-minute Angular lab. Starting with a slow event filter, you’ll use computed signals to remove duplicate work and trace which components update as you type.
events.location: Piraeus Workshop Loft, Lab B · Piraeus

events.title: SSR at Scale
events.description: Follow a ticket listing from its first server render through hydration in the browser. In the second half, pairs compare cache policies for pages where seat availability changes between requests.

events.title: Book a Ticket Without a Mouse
events.description: Working in pairs, audit a sample booking form using only a keyboard. You’ll repair a lost focus indicator, make validation errors easier to find, and test the checkout again with a screen reader.
events.location: Kypseli Design Studio, Ground Floor · Athens

events.title: The First Three Seconds: A Frontend Performance Clinic
events.description: Bring a browser performance trace or use the supplied storefront example. Small groups will identify what delays the first useful paint, try one change, and measure it on a throttled connection.

events.title: Designing a Booking API That Handles Retries
events.description: What happens when two people request the last seat? In this two-hour backend workshop, you’ll model a reservation, replay a timed-out request, and write a test that catches duplicate bookings.

events.title: Frontend Lightning Talks: Lessons from Production
events.description: Three ten-minute talks cover a hydration mismatch, a date picker that broke across time zones, and a search box that returned stale results. Each speaker will show the failing case before walking through the fix.
events.location: Railway Arts Hall, Screening Room · Thessaloniki
